title: Bouldering in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Day tickets sit in a narrow band.** The main independent halls charge **€12 to €14.50** for an adult day, urban apes **€13.90** (€14.90 in Friedrichshain), Der Kegel **€11** and the small Ninja Bloc room **€9**. Prices checked on each hall's own page on 18 September 2026.

**Your pace decides the ticket.** A 10-visit card saves about 10 percent. A membership of **€50 to €60** usually overtakes it around the **fifth visit a month**, and at Ostbloc and Südbloc the lowest rate is a **12-month contract**.

**Berlin bouldert is the pass to know.** One app pass for **Bouldergarten, Boulderklub, Elektra, Der Kegel, Ostbloc and Südbloc**: **€59** unlimited or **€39** for four visits, one month's notice. Four visits for €39 is cheaper than any of those six halls' 10-visit cards.

**Urban Sports Club depends on the plan.** **Essential** does not open the boulder halls. **Classic (€75)** does, capped at **8 visits** at most halls, daily at Der Kegel, Ostbloc and Südbloc, and **4** at Berta Block.
**Weekday mornings are the cheap hours.** Off-peak tickets before 14:00 to 16:00 cost **€8** at Südbloc, **€9** at Der Kegel and Ostbloc and **€11** at Boulderklub. Shoe hire adds about **€4**.
**My move:** buy a 10-visit card near your usual route, count your visits for six weeks, then switch to the €39 small pass at four a month or the €59 unlimited pass above that.
